description_en: Calls the GetVpcPrefixListEntries operation to query information about a specified prefix list
description_zh: 调用GetVpcPrefixListEntries接口查询指定前缀列表的信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc get-vpc-prefix-list-entries --prefix-list-id pl-0b7hwu670000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVpcPrefixListEntries

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the prefix list to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的前缀列表的实例ID
parameters.name: prefix_list_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no subsequent query is required.
If a subsequent query is required, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the prefix list to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的前缀列表所在地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query is required.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

PrefixListEntry.description_en: The information about the prefix list
PrefixListEntry.description_zh: 查询的前缀列表的信息

Cidr.description_en: The Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) block of the prefix list

Description.description_en: The description of the prefix list

PrefixListId.description_en: The instance ID of the prefix list

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the prefix list

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
